title: ForwardingMap.remove(Object object): Parameter name does not match interface: Map.remove(Object key)
body:
Is there a reason the parameter name for ForwardingMap.remove(Object object) does not match the interface: Map.remove(Object key)?  In short: 'object' != 'key'
If yes, please kindly explain the history.
Else, can we rename to 'key' to match the interface?
